// Fixture — should be flagged.
//
// An exported *Service method that takes a literal `string` id
// param, calls core.PathJoin directly, and never calls
// paths.IsValidID. Lives in a synthetic service.go (not wails.go).
// This is the canonical wails-bypass shape Cerberus #24 Finding 2
// warns about.

package fixture

type Result struct {
	OK bool
}

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// Create is exported, takes a literal string id, and builds a
// filesystem path without validating the id first.
func (s *Service) Create(id string) Result {
	path := PathJoin("/data", id)
	_ = path
	return Result{OK: true}
}
